description:
This policy setting disables all add-ins for the specified Office 2016 applications.
      
If you enable this policy setting, all add-ins for the specified Office 2016 applications are disabled.

If you disable or do not configure this policy setting, all add-ins for the specified Office 2016 applications are allowed to run without notifying the users, except if application add-ins are required to be signed by Trusted Publishers.
